INSPECTION PROCEDURE (w/o TRAC)

1 Check voltage between terminals (A9) 2 and (A9) 6 of ABS solenoid relay connector.

C Measure voltage between terminals (A9) 2 and (A9) 6 of ABS solenoid relay harness side connector.

OK Voltage: 10 — 14 V
